biography: I'm **Fazley Rabbi**, a Computer Science and Engineering student at **Southeast University, Dhaka**, focused on **full-stack development, artificial intelligence, and algorithmic problem solving**.

I build **full-stack applications** using **Java, Spring Boot, React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MongoDB, and SQL**. I also develop **AI, machine learning, and deep learning projects**, turning technical concepts into practical applications.

I participated in the **ICPC Asia Dhaka Preliminary Contests in 2024, 2025, and 2026**, earning an **Honorable Mention in 2024**. Competitive programming continues to shape how I approach algorithms and solve complex problems.

Alongside development, I work on **research papers** and have contributed to the **THIRA project as a Research Assistant**. I'm active in IEEE Computer Society events and open to software projects, research collaborations, and learning opportunities.
